<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:10">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>חכם ט׳ וכ׳</he> first wise, then foolish &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>טִפְּשִׁים</he>, <he>טִפְּשִׁין</he>, <cite ref="I00685"><he>טִיפְּ׳</he></cite>.
Sabb. 152ᵇ. Y. Pes. IX, end, 37ᵃ; a. fr.—Fem. טִפֶּשֶׁת.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>שזו הט׳ שבבהמה</he> for this (the ass), the stupidest of animals; Tanḥ. Balak 9 <he>הטִפְּשִׁית</he>.
